Archival Dispatch: 32 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Golden Days of Radio, Paul Harvey, Jim's Christmas Stocking, and Louisiana Hayride

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 6 min
Tags: Golden Days of Radio, Frank Bresee, Paul Harvey, Rest of the Story, Elvis Presley, Gandhi, Christmas Radio, BBC, Louisiana Hayride, George Jones, Jimmy Martin, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 37 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 37 resolves 32 historical entertainment, narrative mystery, holiday, and live country music broadcasts: 8 retrospective audio history episodes from Frank Bresee's The Golden Days of Radio (1969–1971, featuring Jack Benny, Bob Hope, Arthur Godfrey, Bing Crosby, and Stan Freberg), 8 classic syndicated broadcasts from Paul Harvey's The Rest of the Story (including the secret origins of Elvis Presley, Mahatma Gandhi's first legal case, and Mario Andretti), 8 holiday drama anthologies and BBC festive specials from Jim's Christmas Stocking (1986–2005), and 8 Saturday night live stage performances from KWKH Shreveport's Louisiana Hayride (featuring George Jones, Jimmy Martin, Faron Young, and The Browns).
